Priya Patel: Hi team — first day! I need HubSpot CRM access, Aircall seat, and the CS playbook/playlists. Who should I ping for seats and quick runthroughs? Also do we have standard call scripts and recordings to review? :wave:
Olivia (IT): Welcome Priya! Can you confirm your Redwood email? I'll start the HubSpot seat request. Also do you need Dialpad or Aircall? (we use Aircall for CS)
Priya Patel: priya.patel@redwood.com — Aircall please. Thanks!
Evan Kim: @Olivia noted. I'll provision HubSpot seat and Aircall license today. FYI our HubSpot seat flow: create seat -> assign role "CS Rep" -> add to "CS - Shared Views". I'll paste the snippet I use:
```
# salesops create seat
hubspot-cli users:create --email priya.patel@redwood.com --role "CS Rep" --team "Customer Success"
```
Olivia (IT): Got it. I'll open the IT ticket and link to Evan's HubSpot action. Ticket: IT-7892. Expect access within 4 hours, ping me if you need MFA help.
Samir N.: Welcome Priya :tada: Quick orientation plan: 1) HubSpot + Aircall setup (today), 2) shadow calls with Maya and Jordan (tomorrow), 3) 1:1 playbook walkthrough with me (Thu). Here's the playbook folder: https://drive.redwood.com/cs-playbooks — start with 'Inbound quick wins' and 'Escalation matrix'.
Priya Patel: Awesome, thank you! Can you add me to the call recordings folder? Also any recommended 30min pre-read?
Samir N.: Added you to recordings. Pre-read: 'Intro to CS KPIs' doc in that folder (start there). Also check 'Call objection cheat sheet'.
OnboardBot: Welcome Priya Patel! Onboarding checklist updated: HubSpot ✅ (in progress), Aircall ✅ (in progress), Slack roles ✅. Next step: schedule 1:1 with Samir. Use /book samir 30m.
Evan Kim: Done — HubSpot seat created (HS-4532), role CS Rep assigned. Aircall license requested with Aircall ticket AC-3321. Olivia, any hiccups on MFA?
Olivia (IT): MFA enrollment email sent. If you don't see it, check spam or run `authy enroll priya.patel@redwood.com` and DM me.
Priya Patel: Got MFA email and HubSpot access. Aircall still pending. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
Samir N.: Welcome aboard again — ping here if anything blocks. We'll set up your first shadow call at 11am PST tomorrow.
